dl.headline:
بطاقات تحمل نوعين لأول مرة
في لعبة Pokémon TCG Pocket
dl.notes: Brief: hook = the surprise (first dual-type cards); format stills (trailer and split at 4/4 for Wednesday; the trailer is YouTube only); opener: Mega Mewtwo X ex card already panning, headline over it; under it our bed neon_c; key shot: the dual-type line lands on Mega Greninja ex; the date line on Mega Dragonite ex (a Dual Fusion card); the art line on Charizard then Blastoise (named in the line); First Partners line on Fuecoco (a first partner). 20.0 s (four lines). Closer angles (card at 1.4x on the same ground) on Greninja and Fuecoco for the 3 to 4 s change rule; date line shortened to «تصل إضافة Dual Fusion في 29 أكتوبر». Runner fixes: headline balance put the game name on line 2, so «في لعبة» leads it; lines at 54 px. Cards composed at 0.98x on a blurred copy of their own art (no upscale). Sources decode: PNG stills only. Arabic: both skills loaded, glossary (إضافة not توسعة; Pokémon in Latin). Grammar stage: no required edits; uncertain: «شركة بوكيمون» (no glossary row; DeepL gives the same), «Pokémon البداية» for First Partner Pokémon (DeepL alternatives: بوكيمون الشريك الأول، بوكيمون المبتدئين). DeepL forward (whole story): حزمة التوسعة (kept إضافة per glossary), بطاقات ثنائية النوع (alternative). Back-check: «بطاقات بنوعين» read as two card types, so headline and X say «بطاقات تحمل نوعين»; rest matched.
